title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat) e stablecoins, bem como atividades de VASP.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.

  • Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • A global organization that acquires and scales vertical market software companies delivering mission-critical solutions in specialized industries.


  • The company focuses on long-term growth, operational excellence, and customer success, providing acquired businesses with a permanent home where they can continue to thrive.


  • Operating with an active mergers and acquisitions strategy, the organization creates a fast-paced environment where finance and operations teams play a crucial role in integrating new businesses and driving scalable processes.


About the role

  • The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle NetSuite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies.


  • This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle NetSuite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes.


  • You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight.


  • Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems.


  • This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration.


  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle NetSuite and connected tools.


  • Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.


  • Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into NetSuite.


  • Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within NetSuite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.).


  • Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards.


  • Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration.


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, including acquired company finance teams, internal technical resources, and group leadership.


  • Present regular updates and recommendations to the group finance and senior leadership.


  • Document system configurations, process flows, and migration procedures for knowledge transfer and audit purposes.


  • Contribute to the refinement of deployment methodologies and onboarding playbooks to drive scalability and efficiency.


Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.


  • 4+ years of experience in ERP migration, financial systems implementation, or post-merger integration.


  • Hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, including system configuration and data migration.


  • Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including multi-entity, intercompany, consolidation, and reporting structures.


  • Proven ability to manage complex projects independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


  • Experience with SQL (4+ years).


  • NetSuite experience.


  • Architectural design experience.


  • Integration experience.


  • Leadership experience.


  • Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented mindset.


Nice to have skills

  • CPA designation.


  • Experience with tools and technologies such as OneWorld, SuiteSuccess, SuiteCloud, ETL processes, CSV imports, data mapping, data cleansing, and integration frameworks.


  • Experience with the implementation and integration of financial systems.


  • Strong collaboration skills.


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-4 with at least 6 hours of overlap required with U.S. time zones.


  • Contractor role — 12-month contract, renewable.


  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).


  • BYOD (bring your own device) required.

  • The company focuses on long-term growth, operational excellence, and customer success, providing acquired businesses with a permanent home where they can continue to thrive.


  • Operating with an active mergers and acquisitions strategy, the organization creates a fast-paced environment where finance and operations teams play a crucial role in integrating new businesses and driving scalable processes.


About the role

  • The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle NetSuite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies.


  • This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle NetSuite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes.


  • You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight.


  • Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems.


  • This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration.


  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle NetSuite and connected tools.


  • Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.


  • Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into NetSuite.


  • Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within NetSuite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.).


  • Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards.


  • Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration.


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, including acquired company finance teams, internal technical resources, and group leadership.


  • Present regular updates and recommendations to the group finance and senior leadership.


  • Document system configurations, process flows, and migration procedures for knowledge transfer and audit purposes.


  • Contribute to the refinement of deployment methodologies and onboarding playbooks to drive scalability and efficiency.


Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.


  • 4+ years of experience in ERP migration, financial systems implementation, or post-merger integration.


  • Hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, including system configuration and data migration.


  • Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including multi-entity, intercompany, consolidation, and reporting structures.


  • Proven ability to manage complex projects independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


  • Experience with SQL (4+ years).


  • NetSuite experience.


  • Architectural design experience.


  • Integration experience.


  • Leadership experience.


  • Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented mindset.


Nice to have skills

  • CPA designation.


  • Experience with tools and technologies such as OneWorld, SuiteSuccess, SuiteCloud, ETL processes, CSV imports, data mapping, data cleansing, and integration frameworks.


  • Experience with the implementation and integration of financial systems.


  • Strong collaboration skills.


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-4 with at least 6 hours of overlap required with U.S. time zones.


  • Contractor role — 12-month contract, renewable.


  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).


  • BYOD (bring your own device) required.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Endpoint Packaging Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Endpoint Packaging Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Buscamos um Desenvolvedor .NET & Angular com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento, testes e manutenção de aplicações Web, APIs e integrações, utilizando bancos de dados SQL/Oracle/Postgres como backend. O profissional atuará na criação de soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas às melhores práticas do mercado, contribuindo ativamente com análises, arquitetura e qualidade do código.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e integração de aplicações Web, APIs e componentes utilizando .NET, .NET Core, Angular, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS e bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Desenvolver Web Forms, aplicações MVC e APIs para apoiar funções de negócio.
  • Participar da análise de requisitos, propondo soluções técnicas e contribuindo com o design e a arquitetura de software.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, identificar problemas e sugerir padrões e melhorias baseadas em ocorrências recorrentes.
  • Fornecer orientação técnico-funcional, compreendendo o negócio, ecossistema e soluções já existentes.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes, revisão de código e documentação.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e entrega com o time de desenvolvimento e gestão.
  • Produzir documentação adequada em todas as etapas do SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Sugerir soluções criativas e alternativas técnicas sempre que aplicável.
  • Trabalhar de forma independente, com mínima supervisão, entregando resultados consistentes.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de programação, conhecimento sólido em OOP e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • (Desejável) Conhecimento em Python para backend.

Qualificações Técnicas (Obrigatórias)

  • Sólida de experiência em desenvolvimento com .NET C#, Web Forms, MVC, Angular, JavaScript e jQuery.
  • Experiência prática em projetos Angular.
  • Forte expertise em .NET e .NET Core, com bom entendimento de Web API, REST e protocolos HTTP.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento como TFS, GitHub ou Git.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de logging como Microsoft Enterprise Library, log4Net, Azure Application Insights, entre outros.
  • Entendimento de provedores de nuvem e seus componentes para implementação de soluções.
  • Ótima compreensão de padrões de projeto, arquitetura e boas práticas para melhoria de performance.
  • Experiência com Angular/ReactJS (desejável) e Vue.js (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em DevOps/DevSecOps.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises complexas e pesquisas técnicas detalhadas quando necessário.

title: Senior JD Edwards E1 Developer (Brazil Localization & Integration Specialist)
description:
Full-time | Remote Primary Hubs: Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay

Secondary Hubs: Colombia, Chile


About Allari

Allari is a global technology solutions provider specializing in high-impact JD Edwards ecosystems. We value deep technical expertise and proactive problem-solving, helping our clients navigate complex regulatory and trade landscapes across the globe.


Position Overview


We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true \"Hybrid\" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a major Global Manufacturing client. You will be responsible for the seamless connection between JDE EnterpriseOne and external Fiscal/Trade engines (e.g., Thomson Reuters, Synchro, or similar). We need someone who understands the \"plumbing\" of Brazil localization—how data flows between JDE and external messaging systems for NFe, GFe, and tax calculations.

Core Specialized Requirements

  • Localization & Trade Integration: Proven experience managing the interface between JDE and external Tax/Global Trade platforms.
  • Brazil Localization Mastery: Expert knowledge of NFe (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) and GFe (Freight Management) workflows.

title: Analista de Conteúdo Sênior  (Orgânico, Performance e Social)
description:
A Cartwave Hub tem como propósito revolucionar os meios de pagamento por meio de tecnologia de ponta, garantindo que nossos clientes tenham os melhores recursos para crescer sem barreiras. Trabalhamos para simplificar cada transação e oferecer uma experiência que seja, ao mesmo tempo, segura, eficiente e fluida.


Nossa equipe atua de forma antecipatória, acompanhando tendências de mercado e incorporando novas tecnologias ao nosso dia a dia — com destaque para o uso cada vez mais estratégico de inteligência artificial para ganho de produtividade, escala e qualidade nas entregas.


Mais do que domínio técnico, buscamos profissionais com curiosidade, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e abertura para explorar novas ferramentas e formas de trabalho, especialmente no uso de AI aplicada às rotinas da área.



Missão da posição

Planejar e executar a estratégia de conteúdo da Cia, conectando posicionamento, geração de demanda e conversão. Atuará em conjunto na estruturação da área de marketing, com autonomia para construir processos, definir abordagens e traduzir a complexidade técnica do software em narrativas de autoridade que acelerem o ciclo de vendas e a retenção de clientes .



Impacto esperado no negócio

  • Geração de leads qualificados (MQLs) e influência direta no pipeline de vendas.
  • Crescimento de presença digital e construção de autoridade técnica da marca.
  • Melhoria na clareza de posicionamento e suporte direto ao funil de marketing.
  • Otimização do NRR (Net Revenue Retention) através de conteúdos educativos que reduzam o Time-to-Value (TTV) .
  • Visibilidade em motores de busca de IA através de estratégias de SEO, GEO e AIO .


Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar o calendário de conteúdo integrando o framework dos 4 E's (Educar, Entreter, Engajar e Empoderar) no LinkedIn.
  • Produzir conteúdo estratégico para diferentes canais: LinkedIn, Instagram e Substack/Newsletters focadas em \"intimidade digital\" .
  • Escrever copies persuasivos para todas as etapas do funil: atração, educação e conversão.
  • Orquestrar a estratégia de \"Founder-Led Growth\" e Employee Advocacy, capacitando lideranças para gerar autoridade em seus perfis pessoais .
  • Desenvolver roteiros de vídeo nativos e carrosséis focados em resolver dores reais do ICP..
  • Acompanhar KPIs de engajamento de qualidade e conversão visitante-para-lead nos diferentes canais de marketing .
  • Organizar fluxos de produção e testar novos formatos com foco em ganho de performance operacional.


O que esperamos de entrega

  • Consistência e qualidade técnica superior na produção de conteúdo.
  • Clareza estratégica e habilidade de atuar como um \"pensador\" da marca, não apenas executor.
  • Conteúdos multiformato que gerem impacto real em receita (Marketing-Sourced Pipeline).


Requisitos

  • Excelente escrita, comunicação técnica e domínio de storytelling B2B.
  • Experiência sólida com conteúdo e social media estratégica em empresas de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento profundo de funil de marketing, copywriting e SEO semântico .
  • Capacidade de organizar e planejar produção de conteúdo com autonomia.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência e/ou grande familiaridade com uso de AI em ferramentas para escala e otimização de rascunhos (ex: Jasper, Copy.ai, Surfer SEO)  
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação (Zapier, Make ou n8n) para distribuição de conteúdo.
  • Experiência prévia no setor SaaS, Fintech ou tecnologia voltada para o mercado corporativo.


Perfil comportamental

  • Criativo e persuasivo para contar histórias, mas rigoroso com a precisão técnica e tom de voz da marca.
  • Curiosidade ativa para testar novas tendências de \"Zero-Click Content\" e canais emergentes.
  • Organizado, consistente e movido por metas de crescimento.
  • Estrategista com forte capacidade de execução


Nível de autonomia esperado

  • Capacidade de identificar gargalos de percepção de marca e implementar narrativas corretivas de forma independente, operando como o mentor da voz da empresa.
  • Capacidade de executar com baixo nível de supervisão
  • Proatividade para identificar problemas e propor soluções
  • Organização para conduzir suas próprias entregas



Detalhes da vaga:

Remuneração: na faixa de R$6.500,00 a R$7.500,00 (a depender da senioridade)

Tipo de contratação: PJ/MEI

Ausência Remunerada: 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir com a família, etc.

Plano de carreira: Aqui, valorizamos o crescimento profissional. Nossa estrutura de cargos e salários é bem definida, com trilhas claras de evolução por mérito e performance e escopo.


Esta oportunidade é para trabalho remoto , onde será necessário que possua espaço físico adequado, equipamentos como computador e celular, além de garantir uma internet de qualidade.

  • Desenvolver roteiros de vídeo nativos e carrosséis focados em resolver dores reais do ICP..
  • Acompanhar KPIs de engajamento de qualidade e conversão visitante-para-lead nos diferentes canais de marketing .
  • Organizar fluxos de produção e testar novos formatos com foco em ganho de performance operacional.


O que esperamos de entrega

  • Consistência e qualidade técnica superior na produção de conteúdo.
  • Clareza estratégica e habilidade de atuar como um \"pensador\" da marca, não apenas executor.
  • Conteúdos multiformato que gerem impacto real em receita (Marketing-Sourced Pipeline).


Requisitos

  • Excelente escrita, comunicação técnica e domínio de storytelling B2B.
  • Experiência sólida com conteúdo e social media estratégica em empresas de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento profundo de funil de marketing, copywriting e SEO semântico .
  • Capacidade de organizar e planejar produção de conteúdo com autonomia.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência e/ou grande familiaridade com uso de AI em ferramentas para escala e otimização de rascunhos (ex: Jasper, Copy.ai, Surfer SEO)  
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação (Zapier, Make ou n8n) para distribuição de conteúdo.
  • Experiência prévia no setor SaaS, Fintech ou tecnologia voltada para o mercado corporativo.


Perfil comportamental

  • Criativo e persuasivo para contar histórias, mas rigoroso com a precisão técnica e tom de voz da marca.
  • Curiosidade ativa para testar novas tendências de \"Zero-Click Content\" e canais emergentes.
  • Organizado, consistente e movido por metas de crescimento.
  • Estrategista com forte capacidade de execução


Nível de autonomia esperado

  • Capacidade de identificar gargalos de percepção de marca e implementar narrativas corretivas de forma independente, operando como o mentor da voz da empresa.
  • Capacidade de executar com baixo nível de supervisão
  • Proatividade para identificar problemas e propor soluções
  • Organização para conduzir suas próprias entregas



Detalhes da vaga:

Remuneração: na faixa de R$6.500,00 a R$7.500,00 (a depender da senioridade)

Tipo de contratação: PJ/MEI

Ausência Remunerada: 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir com a família, etc.

Plano de carreira: Aqui, valorizamos o crescimento profissional. Nossa estrutura de cargos e salários é bem definida, com trilhas claras de evolução por mérito e performance e escopo.


Esta oportunidade é para trabalho remoto , onde será necessário que possua espaço físico adequado, equipamentos como computador e celular, além de garantir uma internet de qualidade.

title: Lead Backend Java Engineer with Devops
description:
Principal Java Engineer - Full Stack Backend Engineer with DevOps experience

Shift Timings: USA, PST (Pacific Standard Time)

Location: Remote (Brazil)


We're seeking a seasoned Java Engineer who can own services end-to-end, from development through production infrastructure management.


What You'll Do:

  • Design and build scalable APIs and backend services using Java
  • Implement security best practices including authentication, authorization, and secure coding
  • Develop event-driven architectures using Kafka
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases
  • Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform
  • Deploy and orchestrate services with Kubernetes


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of Java development experience (Spring Boot preferred)
  • Strong API development and RESTful design skills
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka and PostgreSQL
  • Proven ability with Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Security-minded approach to development
  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Ability to own projects from concept to production


Requirements:

  • Must have overlapping working hours with PST (Pacific Standard Time)
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Self-starter who can work independently

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
A Immunomatics é uma startup sediada em San Diego, Califórnia, com a missão de melhorar os desfechos dos transplantes de órgãos por meio da seleção otimizada de doadores assistida por inteligência artificial (IA).


A empresa busca contratar profissionais brasileiros com conhecimento avançado em arquiteturas de deep learning.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar, testar e validar modelos de IA para estratificação de risco.


O que buscamos

  • Pós-graduação em Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Matemática.
  • Publicação de artigos científicos envolvendo o uso de redes neurais.
  • Experiência em projetar e implementar novas arquiteturas de redes neurais ou em personalizar arquiteturas existentes (CNN, RNN, Autoencoders, Transformers, etc.) para melhorar o desempenho preditivo do modelo.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de métodos e ferramentas computacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Bônus: Experiência em Bioinformática.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com experiência sólida em Java, que tenha atuado no desenvolvimento de aplicações backend.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Java 8+
  • Spring 2+ (Avançado)
  • SQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Arquiteturas Monolito e Microsserviços
  • Git (Avançado)
  • Event Sourcing (Avançado)
  • Design Patterns (Avançado)
  • SOLID (Avançado)
  • Event Driving (Avançado)
  • DDD (Avançado)
  • RabbitMQ (Avançado)
  • Kafka (Avançado)
  • Observabilidade (Conceitos)
  • Sustentação/Troubleshooting
  • Pirâmide de Testes (Unitário, Integração, End2End)
  • AWS SQS
  • AWS Glue
  • AWS S3
  • Terraform
  • Docker
  • Python
  • Conceitos de Engenharia de Prompt e IA
  • Uso de Copilot integrado ao Desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais:

  • Segurança de Aplicações
  • Arquitetura de Front-end
  • Java 17+
  • Kotlin
  • Spring 3+ (Avançado)
  • NoSQL (Conceitos)
  • Redis
  • MongoDB
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS Secrets Manager
  • Demais serviços AWS
  • GCP
  • Kubernetes
  • Pipelines CI/CD


Onde você irá trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com experiência sólida em Java, que tenha atuado no desenvolvimento de aplicações backend.

  • Java 8+
  • Spring 2+ (Avançado)
  • SQL
  • PostgreSQL

  • Uso de Copilot integrado ao Desenvolvimento.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Who we are

We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!


Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.


You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.


About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.


You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .

title: Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.

title: Blockchain Payments Coordinator
description:
InvesTec UAE is a forward-looking technology company operating at the intersection of fintech and blockchain innovation. We are focused on building efficient, scalable financial infrastructure powered by digital assets, enabling seamless global payments through blockchain technology.


As we expand our operations, we are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Blockchain Payments Coordinator to support and optimize our crypto payment processes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the core of digital asset operations and contribute to the evolution of next-generation financial systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily blockchain payment operations, including transaction processing, monitoring, and tracking.
  • Assist in managing crypto wallets, ensuring accuracy in transfers and balances.
  • Support reconciliation of transactions across wallets, exchanges, and internal systems.
  • Monitor payment flows and identify discrepancies or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, and finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of transactions and prepare operational reports.
  • Assist in managing relationships with payment providers, exchanges, and blockchain partners.
  • Stay updated on blockchain trends, tools, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.


Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in crypto, blockchain operations, fintech, or payments coordination.
  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency

A .add é uma empresa de TI e inovação, com 25 anos no mercado. Estamos localizados no São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Miami. Com atuação marcante no mercado brasileiro, desenvolvemos soluções eficientes de forma singular para entregar os melhores serviços e produtos nas áreas de Inovação e Tecnologia. Nosso diferencial está na expertise de um time multidisciplinar e comprometido com as melhores práticas ágeis utilizadas para superar desafios corporativos e garantir resultados extraordinários com precisão, agilidade e segurança.

Tecnologia, Liderança, Agilidade, Inovação e Pessoas, são os pontos que formam a essência da .add.

Aqui na .add você vai encontrar:

  • Ambiente colaborativo
  • Hibrído SP;
  • Oportunidade PJ;
  • Circuito de treinamentos
  • Programa de Educação Continuada
  • Desafios e oportunidades de crescimento

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter microserviços Java em ambientes de produção
  • Inglês avançado
  • Projetar e otimizar APIs RESTful usando Spring Boot
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e desempenho de sistemas distribuídos
  • Colaborar com arquitetos de software na definição de padrões e boas práticas

Orquestração de APIs via iComposer (Groovy – low-code).

title: Business Development Manager - LatAm Focus
description:
The Mandate: Forging New Paths to Prosperity


We are seeking a full-time BDM with a proven client portfolio and the confidence to open entirely new markets for our portfolio.


✅ Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Client Acquisition: Proactively develop and secure new clients, with a sharp focus on expanding Fa Chai Gaming's presence and securing major deals across Central and South America.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy: Submit regular, insightful reports on regional business developments and market trends, providing actionable recommendations to guide our strategic decision-making and product adaptation.
  • Ambassador & Host: Represent Fa Chai Gaming at key iGaming exhibitions and industry events, adeptly hosting clients and nurturing new business relationships face-to-face.
  • Relationship Nurturing: Undertake periodic business trips across the region to maintain and deepen strategic client relationships, ensuring high client satisfaction and sustained commercial growth.


What Brings You Fortune (Requirements & Skills)


  • Language Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in both English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus).
  • Industry Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional sales experience in the online gaming/iGaming B2B sector.
  • Existing Client Resources: Must possess an established and active network of operator contacts within the LatAm market, with a proven ability to convert leads into major commercial partnerships.
  • Industry Preference: Candidates with previous sales or business development experience working for established European or American gaming providers/platforms will be strongly preferred.
  • Market Expertise: A deep understanding of the regulatory landscape, operator needs, and player preferences within the Central and South American market is a strong advantage.
  • Location Advantage: A current base of operations within Brazil or a major LatAm market hub is highly desirable.


Are you ready to build a new empire for Fa Chai Gaming and take the lead in LatAm?


If you have the network, the drive, and the ambition to succeed in a fast-paced environment where growth is the ultimate metric, apply now.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Programa Jovem Aprendiz 2026
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará: Jovem Aprendiz (Administrativo/Produção):

  • Auxiliar nas rotinas dos Departamentos;
  • Realizar atendimento, acompanhamento de relatórios, input de dados em sistema;
  • Atender outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao programa.


Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga?

  • Ensino médio cursando ou completo
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office
  • Ter entre 18 e 22 anos


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Refeitório no local (para os dias presenciais no Complexo Butantan);
  • Vale Refeição (para os dias de treinamento externo);
  • Ônibus fretado - Instituto Butantan/ Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Descontos em parcerias de entretenimentos;
  • Ingressos para os museus do Butantan;
  • Totalpass – benefício focado na saúde e bem estar dos colaboradores;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e auto avaliação;
  • Participação em palestras e Workshops realizados no Butantan;
  • Mentoria;
  • Day Off de aniversário – O (a) Aprendiz terá direito a uma folga no mês do aniversário, acordado com a gestão.


Informações complementares:

Período de inscrições: 16/03/2026 a 30/03/2026

Quantidade de vaga(s): 60

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil

Horário de trabalho: 08h às 14h15 ou 12h às 18h15

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;
  • Entrevista individual com o requisitante;
  • Entrevista individual com o gestor do requisitante.


Todas as etapas são eliminatórias e podemos indicar uma ou mais etapas a informar no processo seletivo.


*Validade do processo seletivo: 06 meses
