title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Job

What if every conversation you have, every partnership you build, could accelerate the progress of life science research and precision medicine?

At GeneMind, we are dedicated to making life readable and health actionable through independent innovation in high-throughput gene sequencing technology. We break global technological barriers, deliver accessible and reliable genomic tools to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions worldwide, and empower scientists and clinicians to turn data into discovery—and discovery into real-world impact.

Working at GeneMind means joining a mission-driven team that combines cutting-edge R&D, industrial execution, and global growth. You will not only sell products but also shape the future of the genomics industry. Supported by passionate innovators, strong technical platforms, and a fast-growing global market, you will grow faster, achieve more, and build a meaningful career in one of the most promising fields of our time.


Position Summary

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Sales Specialist / Sales Manager will be the key commercial driver for GeneMind in assigned territories. You will build channel ecosystems, develop key accounts and KOL networks, drive market expansion, and deliver sustainable sales growth. This is a customer-centric, technical, and strategic sales role that combines channel management, key customer development, market insight, and cross-team collaboration—not just order execution. You will directly contribute to GeneMind’s global expansion and market leadership in next-generation sequencing (NGS).


Key Measures Of Success

  • Achievement of quarterly and annual sales targets, revenue, and order intake
  • Healthy channel partner development, activation, and retention
  • Successful development of key accounts and KOL relationship building
  • Accurate market intelligence collection and competitive strategy support
  • High customer satisfaction and long-term partnership loyalty
  • Effective product training and capability improvement for channel partners


Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage channel partners in assigned regions, expand market coverage, and build a stable, high-quality distribution system.
  • Identify and develop key customers and KOLs; establish long-term, trusted professional relationships.
  • Collect and analyze market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs to support regional sales strategies.
  • Deliver professional product presentations and online/offline training to channel partners to improve their sales and technical capabilities.
  • Support partners to close deals, including joint customer visits, demand analysis, solution design, and project follow-up.
  • Develop and execute quarterly and annual regional sales plans, ensure target delivery, and maintain healthy sales funnel management.

  • Professional, self-motivated, and target-oriented with strong learning and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build trust with partners, KOLs, and research clients.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently as needed.
  • High integrity, customer-first mindset, and alignment with GeneMind’s mission and values.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in the life science or IVD industry.
  • Existing channel resources, customer network, or KOL connections in regional markets.
  • Experience in technical sales or solution-based sales (not just transactional).
  • Strong presentation, training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with NGS workflows, clinical diagnostics, or life science research scenarios.
  • Global market exposure or cross-cultural communication experience is a plus.


Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of gene sequencing systems with independent core intellectual property. We develop and produce high-performance sequencing platforms to support scientific research and precision medicine across the globe. We embrace diversity, encourage growth, and empower every team member to create real impact.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Event Operations Specialist
description:
About the job


Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.



Who we are


We’re a real Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up—with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Event Operations Specialist provides hands-on support in the planning and delivery of ecoPortal’s sponsored and community events. Working closely with the Events Manager, Events Operations Specialist, Events Co-ordinator, and the wider Marketing team, this role helps ensure events are well-organised, engaging, and run smoothly from start to finish.


By seamlessly overseeing all aspects of event coordination—from initial planning through to post-event analysis—this specialist will play a pivotal role in solidifying and expanding ecoPortal’s influence and engagement globally.


This is a mid- senior role and would suit someone who is passionate about events, is unflappable in the face of multiple competing priorities, has the willingness to jump in and take charge of a large portfolio of events with a cool, calm head.



Key responsibilities


Event Management

  • Plan and execute successful sponsored events in NZ, AU and UK/EU. Full end-to-end management including but not limited to trade shows, conferences, lunches/dinner, awards.
  • Event management includes third party liaison, run pre-event briefings, manage swag, budgeting, logistics, and post-event analysis.
  • Execute full event debriefs at the conclusion of each event, and disseminate thai information to appropriate stakeholders for consideration. And, make recommendations for improvements and future attendance.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team for pre and event follow up and communications.
  • Work closely with the content and creative teams on all event related comms, branding, promotion, collateral and associated marketing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, customer success, marketing, and product) to ensure events align with overall business objectives and provide value to attendees.
  • Evaluate the success of events and report on key metrics, including attendance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.


Community Engagement and Activation

  • Alongside the Head of Events, research the best H&S events in our target regions and recommend future events.
  • Lead ecoPortal's involvement in health and safety networks, infiltrating key communities, where applicable, attending industry gatherings, and establishing partnerships to strengthen ecoPortal’s reputation and presence.
  • Seek out bespoke opportunities for ecoPortal to participate in local, intimate, and partner industry events to increase brand awareness.
  • Develop and manage relationships with our prospects, customers and those in the Health and Safety industry and build a sense of community within ecoPortal’s customer base.
  • Develop and manage relationships with industry influencers, thought leaders, event organisers, and industry professional organisations.



Qualifications & Experience

  • A willingness and a passion to jump in and enjoy the sometimes hectic and unpredictable nature of events!
  • A Bachelor's degree in a suitable field (this may include, but is not limited to these majors) - Business, Marketing/Events, Management, Communications.
  • A minimum of 3 years experience in business events design and execution
  • Very strong organisational skills, you will be dealign with multiple events at any one time and this means you'll need to be an admin wizard.
  • Excellent attention to detail. Managing events across such a busy event calendar means honing in on details, and ensuring all your ducks are in line to ensure smooth execution.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal. With lots of balls in the air it's important that you know how to stay cool and calm, and focused on the task at hand.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, can-do attitude with a willingness to take initiative. This is a senior role - and the expectation is that you'll be able to take ownership of a certain portion of events + mentor and guide others in the team who are more junior.
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first approach.
  • Previous experience in events, customer service, or marketing is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace (Sheets and docs, and familiarity with marketing tools like Trello and Hubspot a bonus).



Perks & Benefits:

We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

  • Realizar o processo de cobrança junto a clientes inadimplentes, negociando a regularização dos títulos em aberto.

title: Site Installation Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In the role of Site Installation Engineer for Medium Gas Turbines (MGT) New Unit, you will work at a customer job site(s) you will be based in Brazil and will serve our global operations around the world. The position requires 80%+ travel to power plant sites internationally.

The Site Installation Engineer typically works in teams of two at the customer job site and owns the customer team by planning all installation activities related to the Gas Turbine scope of equipment. This means, among other things, advising job site logistics, plan the daily work, utilize technical drawings, participate in daily/weekly customer meetings, workforce planning and EHS governance for Siemens Energy related equipment. The Site Installation Engineer frequently interacts with the Siemens Energy project team in Sweden on progress reporting, technical support, and other relevant activities.


How You’ll Make an Impact 

  • The company’s face of the customer, while working on the customer job site.
  • Strive for a good customer relationship utilizing a positive and solution-oriented attitude.
  • Maintaining good progress in co-operation with both the customer team and Siemens Energy project team.
  • Reporting, keeping up to date documentations
  • Ensuring compliance with Siemens Energy procedures and EHS/Quality standards.


What You Bring 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • Experience in installation of gas turbines.
  • Experience working in the field within industry with focus on mechanical and/or electrical work.
  • Strong collaborator with expertise in risk management and adaptability.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and quick to learn other software as needed.
  • Willing to travel domestically and internationally up to 80% and proficient in English (verbal and written).
  • Ability to lead, leadership skills. Experience from managing/leading small teams in an advantage,

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.


Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: 


Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.


Rewards/Benefits
  • Career growth and development opportunities
  • Supportive work culture
  • Company paid Health and wellness benefits
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Private Pension
  • Parental leave

title: Paid Media Coordinator - LinkedInAds
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,300 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Coordinator to support the execution of global paid digital marketing campaigns, partnering closely with recruiting teams to broaden reach, solidify awareness, and drive engagement among executive audiences. In this role, you will manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across platforms (primarily ), with increasing responsibility for performance reporting, cross-team communication, and center-of-excellence (CoE) growth in this rapidly scaling function.


Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Execution & Project Management

  • You will partner with global marketing and recruiting teams to implement campaigns, with potential execution across Display, Demand Base, Google Ads, Meta as well.
  • You will manage campaign timelines, deliverables, and workflows using tools like Trello and Kapost.
  • You will own end-to-end campaign coordination: audience builds, creative trafficking, asset QA, go-live, and monitoring.
  • You will support the creative development process by coordinating asset needs and advising on what to run—drawing from historical performance, cross-regional learnings, and campaign objectives—to ensure assets are optimized and platform-ready.
  • You will manage campaign budgets, billing, and vendor invoicing.


Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • You will coordinate with marketing and recruiting team colleagues, ensuring alignment across stakeholder groups and campaign objectives.
  • You will provide regular status updates and post-campaign summaries to multiple stakeholder groups.
  • You will cultivate trusted working relationships across geographies with increasing ownership over time.
  • You will play an active role in teaching and training recruiting teams on digital best practices by building a scalable library of case studies, playbooks, and success stories to turn stakeholders into digital believers and promoters.


Reporting & Insights

  • You will support campaign reporting, tracking KPIs across platforms to assess performance and optimization opportunities.
  • You will assist in synthesizing data into practical insights using Excel and PowerPoint.
  • You will develop toward the ability to independently derive insights and communicate them effectively.


Learning & Development

  • You will build a working understanding of paid social strategy, audience segmentation, and platform capabilities (with a focus on ).
  • You will engage in testing and learning initiatives to refine targeting and creative performance.
  • You will demonstrate curiosity and initiative to develop analytical skills and marketing fluency.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Digital campaign execution – ability to manage end-to-end paid media campaigns primarily on including creative trafficking, pacing and reporting
  • Cross-functional project management – strong organizational and time management skills to juggle high volume of campaigns, stakeholders and platforms
  • Analytics and reporting insights – ability to track and interpret digital performance metrics deriving actionable insights and interpreting to non-marketing audiences
  • Relationship management and strong communication – strong written and verbal communication skills to build trust with global stakeholders and building strong collaboration and desire for improvement


Principal Accountabilities and % of time

  • Execute and manage global paid digital campaigns across in support of recruiting audiences across the globe– 50%
  • Support campaign performance tracking, reporting and insights development – 20%
  • Stakeholder alignment and communication across geographies – 10%
  • Help build case libraries, templates and training resources to upskill internal teams – 5%
  • Support additional team priorities and special projects as needed – 15%


Experience:

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent digital campaigns, each with distinct goals, timelines, and stakeholder needs, all while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills; thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with minimal oversight.
  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership; eager to learn and grow in a rapidly evolving space.
  • Foundational experience with Ads; interest in expanding into platforms like Meta, Demandbase and Google Ads.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including sharp copywriting skills for social content.
  • Proficient in or quick to learn project and content management tools such as Trello and Kapost.
  • Ability to independently analyze campaign performance and optimize based on insights.
  • Experience developing campaign briefs or contributing to digital strategy.
  • Familiarity with multi-channel digital ecosystems and measurement approaches.
  • Proactive identification of opportunities to enhance campaign impact across markets.
  • Confidence in synthesizing and presenting insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience with Excel modeling and data visualization for executive reporting.
  • Strong ownership mindset with a drive to improve processes and results.
  • Collaborative and respectful teammate across global teams.
  • Demonstrates adaptability, resilience, and a learning mindset in ambiguous or evolving situations.


Education OR equivalent combination of education, training, and experience:

  • Education, training, and hands-on experience in digital marketing or campaign management with exposure to Ads or multi-channel campaign execution


Additional Requirements:

  • Flexibility to work across time zones, including regular communication with the team lead based in U.S. Central Standard Time (CST), and in close collaboration across global teams and stakeholders


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to manage global digital campaigns and grow within a fast-scaling marketing function.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Pessoa Analista de Automação de Dados Pleno (TEMPORÁRIO)
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Automação de Dados Pleno para integrar um projeto estratégico em uma multinacional líder no setor de cuidados visuais. Se você é um profissional com forte bagagem técnica em automação, mas que também transita bem entre as áreas de negócio e TI, essa oportunidade é para você!


Sobre a Empresa

Uma das maiores empresas do mundo no segmento de saúde ocular, com presença global e foco constante em inovação tecnológica para melhorar a visão das pessoas. O ambiente é dinâmico, colaborativo e oferece exposição internacional.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Automação de Processos: Desenvolver automatizações para rotinas de pricing, promoções, margens e governança.
  • Pipeline de Dados: Criar e manter fluxos de dados (ETL/ELT) conectados ao Data Lake (AWS), garantindo a integridade dos KPIs.
  • Visualização: Construir dashboards automatizados (Tableau/Power BI) para monitoramento de métricas-chave e rentabilidade.
  • Integração: Realizar a ponte técnica entre sistemas internos, planilhas e bases transacionais.
  • Apoio Estratégico: Utilizar SQL e Python para gerar insights que suportem decisões da área comercial e de Revenue Management.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Técnicos: Domínio avançado de SQL (indispensável) e proficiência em Python para automações e scripts.
  • Data Lake: Experiência prática com plataformas de nuvem, preferencialmente AWS.
  • Visualização: Experiência com Tableau ou ferramentas equivalentes.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado para interação constante com equipes no México (conversação fluente é essencial).
  • Comportamental: Perfil autônomo, comunicativo e que atue como \"ponte\" entre o técnico e o negócio.
  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (experiência prática é altamente valorizada).


Informações Adicionais

  • Modelo de Trabalho: 100% presencial próximo a estação Vila Olimpia(São Paulo/SP).
  • Contrato: Temporário
  • Benefícios: Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte e Seguro de Vida.


Palavras-chave:

Data Automation, SQL, Python, ETL, AWS, Data Lake, Tableau, Pricing, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Management.

title: Representante externo de vendas
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Vendedor Externo dedicado para integrar nossa equipe localizada em Marília, SP, com foco em soluções em energia solar fotovoltaica. O profissional será responsável por identificar oportunidades de vendas, prospectar novos clientes, apresentar produtos e serviços da empresa e acompanhar o ciclo completo de vendas. Outras responsabilidades incluem a construção de relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes e a realização de visitas externas para negociações. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer atuação presencial.

Qualificações

  • Habilidades de Vendas: Experiência em vendas externas, prospecção de clientes e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para cada perfil.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades interpessoais e de negociação para interagir e desenvolver relações de confiança com os clientes.

title: Analista de Implementação Sênior SaaS B2B para moda e e-commerce (WhatsApp | Automação | IA)
description:
Estamos construindo soluções que transformam o atendimento no atacado de moda usando WhatsApp, automação e inteligência artificial. Buscamos uma pessoa de implementação com perfil mão na massa, curiosa e orientada a resultado, para ativar clientes, criar experiências inteligentes e evoluir o produto junto com o time.


Se você gosta de resolver problemas reais, trabalhar perto de clientes e ver seu impacto acontecer rápido, essa vaga é para você.


Sobre a oportunidade


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Conduzir onboardings completos: diagnóstico, plano de ação, configuração, testes e go-live
  • Implementar agentes de IA, escrevendo prompts e ajustando fluxos conversacionais
  • Configurar automações e integrações via API (webhooks e REST)
  • Criar e otimizar templates de WhatsApp e orientar clientes sobre políticas da Meta
  • Desenhar jornadas de conversa com foco em conversão e experiência
  • Ser ponte entre cliente, produto e engenharia, levando feedbacks que viram melhorias reais
  • Organizar a carteira de clientes e registrar atividades no HubSpot
  • Manter documentações e playbooks sempre atualizados


O que buscamos

  • 3+ anos de atuação com sistemas SaaS
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para lidar com clientes
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a solução
  • Interesse por automação, IA e experiências conversacionais
  • Vivência em startups ou ambientes de crescimento rápido
  • Residir em São Paulo ou Grande São Paulo.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com WhatsApp API ou chatbots
  • Noções de integrações, webhooks ou APIs REST


Como trabalhamos

  • Time enxuto, sem burocracia e com decisões rápidas
  • Contato direto com clientes e impacto visível no produto
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com espaço para testar ideias e melhorar processos


Detalhes sobre a posição

  • Modelo: Híbrido (2x por semana no escritório)
  • Local: Brás – São Paulo (SP)
  • Horário: 8h30 às 17h30, segunda a sexta
  • Regime: PJ


Remuneração e benefícios

  • Salário: R$ 4.500
  • Benefícios: R$ 1.500
  • Ajuda de custo presencial: R$ 70/dia
  • Férias remuneradas
  • Folga no aniversário
  • 13º e FGTS (benefícios equiparados ao CLT)
  • Bônus por performance

title: Analista de Conteúdo Sênior (Orgânico, Performance e Social)
description:
A Cartwave Hub tem como propósito revolucionar os meios de pagamento por meio de tecnologia de ponta, garantindo que nossos clientes tenham os melhores recursos para crescer sem barreiras. Trabalhamos para simplificar cada transação e oferecer uma experiência que seja, ao mesmo tempo, segura, eficiente e fluida.


Nossa equipe atua de forma antecipatória, acompanhando tendências de mercado e incorporando novas tecnologias ao nosso dia a dia — com destaque para o uso cada vez mais estratégico de inteligência artificial para ganho de produtividade, escala e qualidade nas entregas.


Mais do que domínio técnico, buscamos profissionais com curiosidade, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e abertura para explorar novas ferramentas e formas de trabalho, especialmente no uso de AI aplicada às rotinas da área.



Missão da posição

Planejar e executar a estratégia de conteúdo da Cia, conectando posicionamento, geração de demanda e conversão. Atuará em conjunto na estruturação da área de marketing, com autonomia para construir processos, definir abordagens e traduzir a complexidade técnica do software em narrativas de autoridade que acelerem o ciclo de vendas e a retenção de clientes .



Impacto esperado no negócio

  • Geração de leads qualificados (MQLs) e influência direta no pipeline de vendas.
  • Crescimento de presença digital e construção de autoridade técnica da marca.
  • Melhoria na clareza de posicionamento e suporte direto ao funil de marketing.
  • Otimização do NRR (Net Revenue Retention) através de conteúdos educativos que reduzam o Time-to-Value (TTV) .
  • Visibilidade em motores de busca de IA através de estratégias de SEO, GEO e AIO .


Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar o calendário de conteúdo integrando o framework dos 4 E's (Educar, Entreter, Engajar e Empoderar) no .
  • Produzir conteúdo estratégico para diferentes canais: , Instagram e Substack/Newsletters focadas em \"intimidade digital\" .
  • Escrever copies persuasivos para todas as etapas do funil: atração, educação e conversão.
  • Orquestrar a estratégia de \"Founder-Led Growth\" e Employee Advocacy, capacitando lideranças para gerar autoridade em seus perfis pessoais .
  • Desenvolver roteiros de vídeo nativos e carrosséis focados em resolver dores reais do ICP..
  • Acompanhar KPIs de engajamento de qualidade e conversão visitante-para-lead nos diferentes canais de marketing .
  • Organizar fluxos de produção e testar novos formatos com foco em ganho de performance operacional.


O que esperamos de entrega

  • Consistência e qualidade técnica superior na produção de conteúdo.
  • Clareza estratégica e habilidade de atuar como um \"pensador\" da marca, não apenas executor.
  • Conteúdos multiformato que gerem impacto real em receita (Marketing-Sourced Pipeline).


Requisitos

  • Excelente escrita, comunicação técnica e domínio de storytelling B2B.
  • Experiência sólida com conteúdo e social media estratégica em empresas de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento profundo de funil de marketing, copywriting e SEO semântico .
  • Capacidade de organizar e planejar produção de conteúdo com autonomia.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência e/ou grande familiaridade com uso de AI em ferramentas para escala e otimização de rascunhos (ex: Jasper, Copy.ai, Surfer SEO)  
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação (Zapier, Make ou n8n) para distribuição de conteúdo.
  • Experiência prévia no setor SaaS, Fintech ou tecnologia voltada para o mercado corporativo.


Perfil comportamental

  • Criativo e persuasivo para contar histórias, mas rigoroso com a precisão técnica e tom de voz da marca.
  • Curiosidade ativa para testar novas tendências de \"Zero-Click Content\" e canais emergentes.
  • Organizado, consistente e movido por metas de crescimento.
  • Estrategista com forte capacidade de execução


Nível de autonomia esperado

  • Capacidade de identificar gargalos de percepção de marca e implementar narrativas corretivas de forma independente, operando como o mentor da voz da empresa.
  • Capacidade de executar com baixo nível de supervisão
  • Proatividade para identificar problemas e propor soluções
  • Organização para conduzir suas próprias entregas



Detalhes da vaga:

Remuneração: na faixa de R$6.500,00 a R$7.500,00 (a depender da senioridade)

Tipo de contratação: PJ/MEI

Ausência Remunerada: 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir com a família, etc.

Plano de carreira: Aqui, valorizamos o crescimento profissional. Nossa estrutura de cargos e salários é bem definida, com trilhas claras de evolução por mérito e performance e escopo.


Esta oportunidade é para trabalho remoto , onde será necessário que possua espaço físico adequado, equipamentos como computador e celular, além de garantir uma internet de qualidade.

title: Vendedor(a) Social Selling - Dissecando Questões
description:
Resumo: Atue na linha de frente comercial de uma EdTech em plena expansão, focada na preparação para concursos de Institutos Federais. Sua missão é transformar o engajamento do nosso Instagram em matrículas, utilizando prospecção ativa e técnica de vendas consultiva.

Remuneração: R$ 5.000,00+/mês (Fixo de R$ 2.000,00 + 5% de Comissão) + Bônus por Desempenho (Essa é a remuneração padrão dos nossos vendedores)

Contrato: PJ | 100% Remoto.

Seleção: Triagem de currículo via e-mail + Entrevista técnica e prática. (Leia até o fim para se candidatar)


O Desafio

Não buscamos apenas um \"atendente\", mas um vendedor de alto impacto . Você será o responsável por transformar seguidores e interessados em alunos, conduzindo o funil desde o primeiro direct até o fechamento. Se você tem \"sangue nos olhos\", gosta de bater metas e domina a arte da persuasão por mensagem, esta vaga é sua.


Suas Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção Ativa: Abordar seguidores, pessoas que interagem com stories/posts e leads que chegam via direct.
  • Social Selling: Iniciar conversas naturais e estratégicas, fugindo de scripts robóticos.
  • Gestão de Funil: Qualificar leads, realizar follow-ups consistentes e registrar oportunidades.
  • Foco em Performance: Bater metas semanais e mensais de vendas, trabalhando em sintonia com o Marketing.


O que buscamos (Requisitos)

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas (SDR, Closer, Social Selling ou Atendimento Comercial).
  • Escrita impecável e comunicação persuasiva.
  • Habilidade em conduzir vendas complexas por texto (Instagram/WhatsApp).
  • Perfil resiliente, organizado e orientado a resultados.


Diferenciais que te colocam na frente

  • Experiência com venda de infoprodutos, mentorias ou cursos .
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e funis de vendas.
  • Histórico de metas agressivas batidas em ambientes de alta performance.


Por que vir para o Dissecando Questões?

Somos referência na preparação de professores para IFs. Temos uma operação validada onde o ganho de R$ 5.000,00+/mês é uma realidade prática do nosso time atual. Oferecemos autonomia, ambiente meritocrático e a chance de crescer em uma empresa com forte presença digital.


Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para com o assunto: Vaga Comercial - (Seu Nome) .


No corpo do e-mail, destaque brevemente seus resultados anteriores com (evite descrições genéricas de IA):

1. Apresentação pessoal (breve)

Quem é você, momento atual e seus objetivos profissionais.

2. Mini currículo

Experiências (mesmo que não formais) e habilidades relevantes para a área comercial.

3. Duas referências

Nome + relação com você + contato (telefone e e-mail).

4. Mini desafio (obrigatório)

Responda em até 5 linhas: Por que você acredita que seria um bom SDR?

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world’s leading cross-border platforms – and we’re just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.


Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.


WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?


You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.


WHAT YOU BRING


  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.


WHO YOU ARE


  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can’t imagine working in any other way, and it’s the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders


PingPong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

  • We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
Remote

Contractor - PJ


Must Have:

  • Back end SDET with hands on coding skills
  • Playwright experience for validating workflows from login to transaction completion on browsers
  • Java development on very complex legacy applications
  • Heavy API testing in a framework (Rest Assured, an API framework)
  • Schema validation, end point validation
  • Experience with any JVM based language (Scala, Groovy, Closure)

  • Large enterprise environment


Plus:

D2D:

This SDET will be working on a project at a global hotel chain to replace their reservation system. The current system is a green screen terminal application that is over 40 years old. It will require all of the functionality from the tests on the old system to work on the new system via software as a service. This will be mostly back end and API testing, with hands on Java coding. Must be expert level in Java development.

title: QA Engineer – Engine Tools (Code Review Focus)
description:
QA Engineer – São Paulo (On-Site Only)

This is not a developer or SDET role.


Before applying, please confirm:

✔ 3+ years of professional QA experience

✔ Experience reviewing code changes (diffs/PRs) in a QA or gatekeeping capacity ✔ Familiarity with C++ or C# in a read-and-analyze context

✔ Professional English (spoken + written)

✔ Available to work fully on-site in São Paulo (NOT hybrid / NOT remote)

✔ Willing to complete a 30-minute technical assessment


Applications that do not meet the required experience level will not be considered. If all of the above applies to you, keep reading please.


About TestFly

TestFly partners with major international gaming brands to deliver high-quality QA services across tools, engines, and game systems. Our São Paulo team collaborates directly with global engineering stakeholders in English-speaking environments.


Role Overview

This is a full-time, on-site QA Engineer role based in São Paulo, focused on revision and code review within an Engine Tools QA team.


We're looking for a QA analyst with a code review and systems testing background. someone who has spent time in engine tools, SDKs, or platform-level software, reviewing changes and communicating findings to engineers.


This role emphasizes critical thinking, structured analysis, and clear technical communication over automation ownership or development output. You will be reviewing code-related changes, validating quality through manual analysis and testing, and collaborating closely with engineers to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities.


This is not a developer or SDET role.


Success is defined by quality of review, clarity of feedback, and contribution to team effectiveness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review code changes and diffs, providing clear, risk-aware QA feedback in a gatekeeping capacity
  • Analyze requirements, specifications, and technical design documentation
  • Collaborate directly with engineers and stakeholders in English
  • Support risk-based testing discussions and validation strategies
  • Estimate and coordinate QA activities aligned with team timelines
  • Mentor other QA team members and promote consistent quality practices
  • Communicate progress, risks, and findings clearly in written updates and meetings


Required Skills & Competencies


  • Proven experience reviewing code changes (diffs/PRs) and providing structured QA feedback in a revision or gatekeeping capacity
  • Familiarity with C++ or C# in a read-and-analyze context . you don't write production code, but you can read a diff, follow logic, and identify risk
  • Experience with engine tools, SDK testing, or systems-level software
  • Strong written communication skills and professional judgment
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal oversight
  • Comfort engaging directly with engineers in technical discussions
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative, fast-paced environment


Preferred Background

  • Prior exposure to platform-level validation
  • Experience with performance testing
  • Familiarity with Java or JavaScript in a QA context
  • Experience with API testing or validating request/response behavior


If you're an experienced QA professional who enjoys analytical review work and collaborating closely with engineers in an on-site, high-accountability environment,we'd love to hear from you.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Us

We are an industry leader in providing technology solutions in Canada. We are one of the largest technology solutions providers, recognized for our ability to deliver and innovate to meet the changing needs of our clients. Our services include IT consulting, managed services, cloud solutions, infrastructure design and implementation, and software development. We take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive, customized solutions to meet the unique needs of each of our clients.


Position Overview

We currently looking for an Executive Assistant to be a supportive force who empowers our Executive Leadership Team. This role can be operated from fully remote capacity.

This role requires a self-starter with a sense of urgency, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with exceptional communication skills and meticulous attention to details. This person should have experience working in an office environment, performing administrative duties, and providing support to executives. Given the dynamic nature of the executive landscape, we rely on executive assistants to be flexible and consistent while maintaining the confidentiality of high-level systems and our day-to-day operations. You will also assist in coordinating company’s leadership planning cadence, general administrative tasks, office management and support various organizational needs. We are looking for a “trusted partner” who can handle the daily challenges, streamline operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of the business.

The successful candidate will be extremely organized with outstanding attention to detail, time management, and professional communication skills. In addition, they will have solid overall business acumen, approach every task and challenge with energy and tenacity, and handle confidential information appropriately.


Responsibilities:

  • Schedule and manage meetings and other calendar events, including sending and accepting electronic invitations, as well as creating and distributing relevant materials in advance.
  • Plan and orchestrate work to ensure that senior executives’ priorities are met, organizational goals are achieved, and best practices are upheld.
  • Participate in team, management, and executive meetings, take and distribute minutes and action items, and follow up on their completion.
  • Coordinate complex scheduling and calendar management, as well as content and flow of information to senior executives.
  • Being the point of contact for general communications for the Executives they support
  • Assist in drafting and sending communications and correspondence.
  • Create, manage, and file monthly expenses.
  • Assist with travel arrangements and keep track of itineraries.
  • Complete reports and assist with special projects as requested.
  • Manage employee vacation calendars for supported teams.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations.
  • Participate in event planning.
  • Assist with general office management duties.
  • Provide additional support to executive team members, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently.
  • Support the coordination of personal calendars and activities as requested
  • Provide general administrative duties as requested


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education in business or related field is an asset
  • Minimum 3-4 years' experience in an administrative role reporting directly to upper management is preferred
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to organize and coordinate multiple projects at once
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other office productivity tools, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
  • Flexible team player willing to do what it takes to get the job done; adaptable and enjoys a challenge
  • Event coordination experience is an asset

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to work remotely in Pacific Time Zone – Vancouver, Canada
  • Comply with background check requirements
  • This position requires reliable internet connection, backup power, and the use of personal equipment such as Desktop/laptop, mouse keyboard, additional monitor screens and a headset

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.


Somos um time pequeno, colaborativo e pragmático — aqui cada pessoa tem impacto real, autonomia e liberdade para propor ideias, testar, iterar e melhorar continuamente nossos sistemas.


O que esperamos de você

Buscamos alguém desenrolado, com capacidade real de aprender rápido, navegar por contextos complexos e colaborar com outras pessoas do time. Valorizamos quem curte compartilhar conhecimento, tem boa comunicação e sabe tomar decisões técnicas com clareza.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na sustentação de sistemas críticos, investigando gargalos e propondo melhorias duradouras.

  • Apoiar e orientar pessoas do time, compartilhando conhecimento de forma clara e colaborativa.
  • Participar da definição técnica de novos produtos desde a concepção até a operação em produção.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • 7 anos de experiência com backend, incluindo atuação em sistemas distribuídos e/ou de alta performance.
  • Proficiência em programação backend (Go, Lua ou C).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de redes e protocolos: HTTP, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP.
  • Experiência com APIs REST/GraphQL e mensageria (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência prática com Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade.


O que valorizamos muito

  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de aprender e ensinar.
  • Colaborar e trocar ideias (aqui a gente resolve desafios difíceis juntos).
  • Critério técnico e visão pragmática — evitar complexidade desnecessária é uma habilidade.
  • Interesse genuíno por segurança aplicada ao desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica, alta taxa de requisições e baixa latência (CDNs, proxies, firewalls, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de OAuth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 e práticas de segurança Web.
  • Familiaridade com containers, Kubernetes e operações orientadas a performance.
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Experiência com Prometheus, Grafana, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado.


Por que vale a pena

  • Flexibilidade total — confia-se no resultado, não no relógio.
  • Zero burocracia corporativa.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Graphic Designer focused on email and lifecycle marketing creative  to join their marketing team. In this role, you will own the visual execution of their email, SMS, and promotional campaigns, working closely with retention, marketing, and creative teams to bring campaigns to life.


This is a high-output, performance-driven role. They run a structured weekly marketing calendar with multiple sends across email and SMS, so speed, organization, and strong creative instincts are critical.


What You'll Do:

Email & Lifecycle Creative

  • Design marketing emails across promotional, campaign, and automated lifecycle flows
  • Create assets for email, SMS, landing pages, and retention marketing campaigns
  • Build modular email systems that allow for quick campaign iteration
  • Translate marketing strategy into high-converting email layouts


Campaign Production

  • Execute weekly marketing calendars with multiple sends per week
  • Design creative for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen flows
  • Collaborate with retention and marketing teams to deliver assets quickly and efficiently
  • Maintain visual consistency across all lifecycle marketing touchpoints


Lifestyle Marketing Creative

  • Design marketing assets using lifestyle photography and brand creative
  • Support marketing campaigns across email, social, and digital placements
  • Help evolve their visual storytelling across campaigns


Optimization & Iteration

  • Work closely with marketing teams to test and improve creative performance
  • Iterate quickly on creative based on campaign results
  • Contribute ideas for new creative concepts and campaign approaches


Their Marketing Workflow:

Their lifecycle marketing operates on a structured weekly campaign calendar, with multiple emails and SMS sends each week. You will work inside this framework by:

  • Designing assets aligned to weekly campaign themes
  • Creating creative that supports multiple sends across a campaign window
  • Building creative that can be reused and iterated on across lifecycle flows
  • They move fast and prioritize clear, high-impact creative that performs, not overly complex designs.


Tools & Experience:

Required

  • Figma
  • Email design systems
  • Experience designing marketing emails
  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design


Nice to Have

  • Understanding of e-commerce and performance marketing


Bonus If You Have:

  • Motion / light animation for marketing assets

title: Social Media & CRM Specialist (PJ) – Grupo Creatonomy
description:
Sobre o Grupo Creatonomy


O Grupo Creatonomy é um ecossistema inovador focado na creator economy, com empresas como a Topshare, que impulsionam criadores de conteúdo e influenciadores digitais. Buscamos um profissional dinâmico para integrar nossa equipe e atuar de forma estratégica na comunicação e relacionamento com nossa comunidade de criadores e parceiros.

O(A) Social Media & CRM Specialist será responsável por fortalecer a presença digital das empresas do grupo Creatonomy e nutrir o relacionamento com nossos criadores através de estratégias de conteúdo e comunicação personalizadas. Este profissional terá um papel fundamental na construção de comunidades engajadas e na otimização da jornada dos criadores em nosso ecossistema.


Responsabilidades e Escopo de Atividades


O escopo de trabalho abrange a totalidade da estratégia de comunicação digital e relacionamento, com ênfase nas seguintes atividades:


1. Gestão de Redes Sociais:

• Planejar, criar e executar calendários de conteúdo para as redes sociais das empresas do Grupo Creatonomy (Instagram, X (Twitter), entre outras).

• Monitorar tendências, interagir com a comunidade e analisar métricas para otimizar o desempenho das publicações.

• Desenvolver estratégias de engajamento e crescimento orgânico para os perfis.


2. Estratégia de CRM e E-mail Marketing:

• Desenvolver e implementar réguas de relacionamento por e-mail para criadores de conteúdo, desde o onboarding até a fidelização.

• Criar e-mails e newsletters com conteúdo relevante, ofertas e atualizações do ecossistema Creatonomy.

• Segmentar bases de dados e analisar o desempenho das campanhas de e-mail marketing.

3. Produção de Conteúdo:

• Colaborar na criação de materiais ricos (e-books, guias, infográficos, webinars) que agreguem valor aos criadores e parceiros.

• Auxiliar na produção de conteúdo audiovisual e textual para diversas plataformas, garantindo a consistência da marca.


4. Suporte ao Ecossistema de Criadores:

• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na experiência do criador através da comunicação.


Requisitos e Qualificações

• Experiência comprovada em gestão de redes sociais e marketing de conteúdo.

• Conhecimento ou vivência com a plataforma RD Station para e-mail marketing e automação de marketing (CRM) será considerado um diferencial.

• Habilidade em redação e comunicação, com foco em storytelling e engajamento.

• Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e otimizar estratégias.

• Proatividade, criatividade e organização.


ATENÇÃO: REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO


APENAS CANDIDATOS COM PORTFÓLIO COMPROVADO DE TRABALHOS RELEVANTES EM SOCIAL MEDIA E/OU CRM DEVEM SE CANDIDATAR. CANDIDATURAS SEM PORTFÓLIO SERÃO DESCONSIDERADAS.
